proposal.reason: Main change is in transport connection selection/setup for P2P and SHM (including NET-vs-local gating, symmetric P2P capability handling, stream sync pairing, and connection-progress logic). Add device-topology because new path-bandwidth-based NET preference logic and path-computation ordering are introduced in topology checks. Add memory because SHM resource ownership/lifecycle is substantively refactored to handle-based shareable allocation/import/close semantics with explicit mapping and cleanup behavior.
